title: FIRE FROM THE PRESENCE OF THE LORD

memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: "Fire came out from the presence of the LORD and consumed the burnt offering and the fat portions on the altar." - Lev 9:24a (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
The fire did not come from Aaron's hands. Priests had laid the wood, arranged the pieces, done everything correctly — and then fire came from the presence of the LORD.

God supplied what human effort could not.

This is a pattern worth recognising. Israel could prepare the altar; only God could send the fire. Elijah could soak the sacrifice with water and pray; only God could answer by fire (1 Kgs 18:38). The disciples could gather and wait in Jerusalem; only God could send the Spirit like tongues of fire (Acts 2:3).

We do our part. We cannot do His.

This should relieve a great deal of pressure. You are not responsible for producing spiritual results. You are responsible for faithful preparation — the praying, the serving, the teaching, the loving. Whether fire falls is God's business.

Paul understood the division exactly: I planted the seed, Apollos watered it, but God has been making it grow (1 Cor 3:6).

Lay the wood. Arrange the offering. Then wait for God to do what only God does.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. Am I trying to produce results that only God can produce?
2. Is there a "wood-laying" task God has given me that I have neglected while waiting for something dramatic?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Father, I will do what You have given me to do. Send the fire that only You can send. Amen.
